Built a planning tool for local teams to review their weekly goals.
It combined interview notes with a clear record of customer requests.
At Fabrikam, I prototyped an assistant for recurring field work.
The assistant helped operators compare schedules and service windows.
Its first pilot covered twelve fictional service districts.
I documented each test and revised the workflow with volunteers.
At Northwind, I designed a small catalog for wholesale buyers.
The catalog grouped products by season and delivery region.
One planning scenario modeled $1.2M in annual orders.
I also built a dashboard for the team's shared inventory.
The dashboard kept a transfor-
mation log for every edited product description.
Fabrikam research informed the search experience in the catalog.
Northwind feedback exposed slow steps in the prototype.
I held weekly reviews and wrote concise notes for both teams.
Those notes connected decisions to the people who requested them.
The software ran locally during an extended trial period.
I translated trial feedback into smaller follow-up tasks.
Each release included a short guide for new participants.
The final review listed open questions and agreed next steps.
